title: Negative Exponents
explanation: Rewrite expressions with negative exponents using positive exponents, and evaluate numerical powers accurately.
A negative exponent means reciprocal, not a negative value. The base must be nonzero.
Base: the repeated factor. Exponent: the power. Reciprocal: one divided by a nonzero quantity.
Move a factor with a negative exponent across the fraction bar, then change its exponent to positive. Do not move unrelated factors.
2^(−3)=1/2³=1/8. The result is positive because the base is positive.
(−2)^(−3)=1/(−2)³=−1/8. Parentheses matter: −2^(−3) is a different expression.
6x^(−1)y²=6y²/x, provided x ≠ 0. Only x has the negative exponent.
WORKED EXAMPLE 4 — POWER OF A POWER
(x^(−2))³=x^(−6)=1/x⁶ for x ≠ 0. Multiply the exponents first.
x³·x^(−5)=x^(−2)=1/x². When multiplying like bases, add exponents.
A negative power of zero is undefined. State all variables originally raised to negative powers are nonzero.
Do not turn 5^(−2) into −25. Do not apply a negative exponent to only the numerator when the entire fraction is grouped.
Combine exponent laws before moving factors across a fraction bar. Convert to positive exponents only at the end.
Negative exponent means reciprocal. Use product, quotient, and power laws consistently; practice 18 problems, review 18 solutions, then take the five-question test.
problems: Invert 3/5 to 5/3 and raise to the first power.
Move a^(−2) into the denominator; b³ stays in the numerator.
The negative exponent applies only to x: 6y²/x.
Move the decimal four places right to obtain 4.5, so the power is −4.
The numerator becomes a⁴b^(−6). Divide by ab^(−1): a³b^(−5)=a³/b⁵.
Numerator is x²/(4y⁴). Dividing by 4x^(−3)y multiplies by x³/(4y), giving x⁵/(16y⁵).

tests.why: (2a)³=8a³; the negative exponent takes its reciprocal.

video_en: Welcome
Negative exponents are a shorthand for reciprocals, not negative numbers.
Core rule
For any nonzero a, a to the negative n equals one divided by a to the positive n.
First example
Two to the negative three is one over two cubed, which is one eighth.
Negative bases
Negative two to the negative three, with parentheses, equals negative one eighth.
Variable factors
Six x to the negative one times y squared becomes six y squared divided by x.
Power of a power
x to the negative two, cubed, becomes x to the negative six, or one over x to the sixth.
Fraction example
Two thirds to the negative three becomes three halves cubed, which is twenty seven eighths.
Exponent products
x cubed times x to the negative five becomes x to the negative two, or one over x squared.
Domains
Zero cannot be raised to a negative power, because division by zero is undefined.
Exam strategy
Combine exponent laws first. Then rewrite the final answer with positive exponents.
Quick check
Three to the negative two is one ninth. Remember to invert the whole base.
Practice
Now solve eighteen practice questions and a five question test.
video_ar: مقدمة
الأس السالب معناه مقلوب العدد، مش إن الناتج سالب.
القاعدة
أي عدد غير صفر مرفوع لأس سالب يساوي واحد على نفس العدد بأس موجب.
مثال
اتنين أس سالب تلاتة يساوي واحد على تمانية.
العدد السالب
سالب اتنين أس سالب تلاتة بين قوسين يساوي سالب واحد على تمانية.
المتغيرات
ستة إكس أس سالب واحد في واي تربيع تساوي ستة واي تربيع على إكس.
أس القوة
إكس أس سالب اتنين الكل تكعيب يساوي واحد على إكس أس ستة.
الكسور
اتنين على تلاتة أس سالب تلاتة يساوي سبعة وعشرين على تمانية.
ضرب القوى
إكس تكعيب في إكس أس سالب خمسة يساوي واحد على إكس تربيع.
المجال
الصفر ماينفعش نرفعه لأس سالب لأن القسمة على صفر غير معرفة.
نصيحة الامتحان
اجمع قوانين الأسس الأول وبعدين حول الأسس السالبة لموجبة.
مراجعة
تلاتة أس سالب اتنين تساوي واحد على تسعة.
التدريب
دلوقتي حل تمنتاشر سؤال تدريب وخمس أسئلة اختبار.
